rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the eight-legged animal.

example.english: This spider is always spinning a web in the corner.
example.traditional: 呢隻蜘蛛成日喺牆角結網。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 zi1 zyu1 seng4 jat6 hai2 coeng4 gok3 git3 mong5

rows.note: A speaker picks this colloquial Hong Kong term for the same animal, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: Hey, that spider is still here—hurry up and get it out!
example.traditional: 喂，嗰隻蠄蟧仲喺度呀，快啲趕佢出去啦！
example.jyutping: wai3 go2 zek3 kam4 lou2 zung6 hai2 dou6 aa3 faai3 di1 gon2 keoi5 ceot1 heoi3 laa1

rows.note: Use this technical term for software that automatically follows web links and gathers information.

example.english: This spider automatically follows web links and gathers information.
example.traditional: 呢個網絡爬蟲會自動跟住網頁連結搜集資料。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 lok6 paa4 cung4 wui5 zi6 dung6 gan1 zyu6 mong5 jip6 lin4 git3 sau1 zaap6 zi1 liu6
